payment.text: Cash to the driver on the day. No prepayment. No hidden fees.

faq.a: Yes. Every transfer is private, with no sharing, so you travel only with your group.

faq.q: How do I pay for my taxi or minivan?
faq.a: You pay in cash to the driver on the day of the transfer. There is no prepayment and no hidden fees.

faq.q: How do I book a transfer?
faq.a: Fill in the request form on this page. It opens WhatsApp with your message ready, and the team replies with the price and the details.

faq.q: Where do you drive in Southern Thailand?
faq.a: Across Southern Thailand: Krabi Town and Krabi airport, Ao Nang, Phuket and Phuket airport, Surat Thani airport and bus terminal, Trang, Khao Lak, Khao Sok, Donsak Pier and Cheow Lan Pier, and more.

faq.q: Do you only drive from Koh Lanta?
faq.a: No. Koh Lanta (also written Ko Lanta) is our base, but we drive across Southern Thailand. Tell us where we pick you up and where you are going in the request form.

faq.q: Do you offer airport transfers to and from Koh Lanta?
faq.a: Yes. We drive private transfers between Krabi, Phuket and Surat Thani airports and Koh Lanta, in both directions.

faq.q: Can I book day tours or boat trips too?
faq.a: Day tours around Koh Lanta and boat trips are handled by Secret Travel & Tour. You can choose a trip and ask for a price on their page.
